subject: RELEASE statement
notes: kb/Work PB349 (landed, wave 56). RULE (cite.py --check 14.9.32.4 'the EC-FLOW-RELEASE exception condition is set to exist' -> OK 14.9.32.4 1)). The sort store now carries the executing statement's procedure PHASE (CobolSort.Store.Phase, set by the emitted EnterProcedure before the INPUT PROCEDURE range and cleared by the sequence phase); the RELEASE STATEMENT renders CobolSort.ReleaseStatement, which raises EC-FLOW-RELEASE through ExceptionState.FlowReleaseError before releasing whenever no store exists for the SD or its phase is not Input. FatalAmbientGates row (EC-FLOW-RELEASE, FlowReleaseChecking) + QueryFor(BoundRelease) give the statement its >>TURN guard, so the condition reaches a USE declarative (14.6.13.1.3 item 5) or terminates (item 7). The implicit USING release keeps the unchecked Release primitive (it is not a RELEASE statement). Checking OFF: nothing is raised (14.6.13.1.1) and the release proceeds, except that a RELEASE with no SORT executing has no store to release to - the 14.6.13.1.3 item 8 implementor choice. Golden pb349_sort_merge_flow_ec: MAIN's RELEASE outside any SORT -> HANDLED=EC-FLOW-RELEASE, the record is not released, and the two RELEASEs inside IN-P raise nothing (negative control).
